$comment: New Project picker. KKD packs, plugins, and flow skills are searchable and default off. Merge kkd-leaf-inclusive.json and kkd-leaf-practice.json for every individual sub-skill.

entries.name: uxfold-core
entries.description: House rules — tokens first, reuse components, keep preview compiling. Copied into the project.

entries.name: uxfold-principles
entries.description: Aesthetic-usability, Pareto, heuristics, Parkinson, pattern catalogues, desirability / feasibility / scale.

entries.name: uxfold-handoff
entries.description: Write a developer handoff note from the live prototype.

entries.name: uxfold-ia
entries.description: Build a sitemap as docs/ia.md (Mermaid) and docs/ia.drawio.

entries.name: uxfold-funnel
entries.description: Label screens TOFU / MOFU / BOFU (or acquire / activate / habit) and write docs/funnel.md.

entries.name: uxfold-moscow
entries.description: Scope the slice with Must / Should / Could / Will-not.

entries.name: uxfold-figma-push
entries.description: Push screens to Figma as frames, new local components, existing local components, or a published library.

entries.name: uxfold-ux-modules
entries.description: Router for the ux-designer modules the designer ticked. Needs ux-designer installed.

entries.name: superpowers
entries.description: Working method — brainstorm, plan, test-first, verify before saying done.

entries.name: claude-mem
entries.description: Remembers past sessions so the agent stops re-learning the project. Claude Code plugin.

entries.name: frontend-design
entries.description: Anthropic anti-slop frontend skill. Show as a tick when creating a project — not forced on.

entries.name: design-taste-frontend
entries.description: Stops generic AI UI. Variance, motion, and density dials.

entries.name: web-design-guidelines
entries.description: Audit UI against Vercel web interface guidelines (a11y, forms, motion, type).

entries.name: writing-guidelines
entries.description: Audit docs and prose against Vercel writing guidelines.

entries.name: ux-writing
entries.description: UX microcopy — buttons, errors, empty states, tone.

entries.name: ux-designer
entries.description: Broad UX skill with topic modules. After ticking this, pick modules from ux-designer-modules.json.

entries.name: ponytail
entries.description: Do less. Reuse what exists, native controls before new libraries.

entries.name: image-to-code
entries.description: Turn a screenshot or reference image into matching frontend code.

entries.name: playwright-cli
entries.description: Browser QA for agents — snapshot, screenshot, click the live preview.

entries.name: kkd-design-flow-pack
entries.description: KKD compact design process pack (8 skills). Search kkd-flow-* to pick individuals.

entries.name: kkd-inclusive-design-pack
entries.description: KKD inclusive design pack (6 plugins). Search kkd-inc-* to pick individuals.

entries.name: kkd-designer-practice-pack
entries.description: KKD design-practice pack (9 plugins). Search kkd-prac-* to pick individuals.

entries.name: kkd-flow-grill-me
entries.description: Interrogate the plan until design decisions are resolved.

entries.name: kkd-flow-design-brief
entries.description: Turn the grilling session into a structured brief.

entries.name: kkd-flow-information-architecture
entries.description: Navigation, hierarchy, page structure, and flows.

entries.name: kkd-flow-design-tokens
entries.description: Colour, type, space, and motion tokens with light and dark.

entries.name: kkd-flow-brief-to-tasks
entries.description: Break the brief into independently buildable slices.

entries.name: kkd-flow-frontend-design
entries.description: Build with a named aesthetic. Not the Anthropic frontend-design skill.

entries.name: kkd-flow-design-review
entries.description: Critique the built work against the brief.

entries.name: kkd-flow-design-flow
entries.description: Run the full KKD design sequence, skip phases you do not need.

entries.name: kkd-inc-cognitive-accessibility
entries.description: Design for how people think: load, language, wayfinding, memory, errors.

entries.name: kkd-inc-inclusive-interaction
entries.description: Multi-modal input and output, keyboard, gestures, status.

entries.name: kkd-inc-accessible-content
entries.description: Alt text, headings, links, forms, tables, readable content.

entries.name: kkd-inc-inclusive-personas
entries.description: Personas and scenarios that include disability from the start.

entries.name: kkd-inc-adaptive-interfaces
entries.description: Respect motion, contrast, type, and density preferences.

entries.name: kkd-inc-accessibility-decisions
entries.description: Document a11y tradeoffs, debt, compliance, handoff.

entries.name: kkd-prac-design-research
entries.description: Personas, journeys, interviews, synthesis, test plans.

entries.name: kkd-prac-ux-strategy
entries.description: Brief, principles, IA, competitive, opportunity, blueprint.

entries.name: kkd-prac-ui-design
entries.description: Colour, type, grid, dark mode, gestalt, hierarchy.

entries.name: kkd-prac-interaction-design
entries.description: Forms, onboarding, errors, states, motion, search.

entries.name: kkd-prac-design-systems
entries.description: Tokens, components, theming, a11y audit, governance.

entries.name: kkd-prac-prototyping-testing
entries.description: Heuristics, prototype plan, A/B, wireframes, flows.

entries.name: kkd-prac-design-ops
entries.description: Critique, handoff spec, sprint, debt, QA checklist.

entries.name: kkd-prac-designer-toolkit
entries.description: Rationale, case study, UX writing, negotiation.

entries.name: kkd-prac-visual-critique
entries.description: Hierarchy, type, colour, density, affordance, brand.

entries.name: obsidian-skills
entries.description: Obsidian markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, Obsidian CLI — useful if specs live in a vault.

entries.name: claude-code-plugins
entries.description: Anthropic first-party plugin marketplace. Claude Code only.
